doc_notes: This document is a 1963 memorandum from the National Aeronautics and Space Council discussing the theoretical policy implications of discovering extraterrestrial intelligence, referencing various speculative lunar phenomena as potential indicators.

incidents.summary: Discovery of hot gases emanating from the lunar crater Alphonsus.
incidents.quote: The discovery of hot gasses eminating from the crater Alphonsus when the moon was supposedly dead.

incidents.summary: Infra-red scans of the moon showing hot spots.
